tree: How do businesses segment customers in a CRM?
Customer segmentation software groups customers by rules such as spend, visit date, location or tags, so each message reaches the people it is meant for.
Sending the same message to everyone feels generic and gets ignored.
Build segments with simple rules and reach each group with the right campaign.
